sourceTitle: Gwen Wynn: A Romance of the Wye
description: "Gwen Wynn: A Romance of the Wye" by Captain Mayne Reid is a romantic novel written in the late 19th century. The story introduces us to Gwendoline Wynn, a spirited young heiress known for her beauty and independence, living in the scenic English countryside near the Wye River.
